$comment: Citation ledger. Every token, contract and rule in this design-repo points at an entry id here (field 'evidence'). Citation paths are relative to the SOURCE PROJECT ROOT (the folder that contains design-repo/), never absolute. When design-repo/ is shipped alone (no sibling source tree), extraction/verify_all.py downgrades citation checks to a warning instead of failing. Each citation carries a 'quote' that must appear (whitespace-normalised) inside the cited line range: this catches in-range-but-wrong citations, not only out-of-range ones. Note: the saved original page's filename contains an em dash followed by a NO-BREAK SPACE (U+00A0), escaped below as \u00a0.

evidenceLevels.source-css: Read directly from a stylesheet (original Webflow CSS port or global embed CSS).
evidenceLevels.source-markup: Read directly from the saved original HTML or the clone's markup.
evidenceLevels.source-code: Read directly from motion/behaviour source code.
evidenceLevels.playwright-measured: Computed style / rect / frame samples recorded in CLONE_SPEC.md from a Playwright run against the live original.
evidenceLevels.qa-measured: Reported by the 2026-10-23 pixel/motion QA pass (clone vs live original). No QA artifact file exists on disk in the source project; recorded verbatim from the QA report handed to this build.
evidenceLevels.requester-reported: Stated by the requester of this build; not present in any on-disk evidence file.
evidenceLevels.inferred: Design-repo policy or inference, not a measurement. Always says so in 'basis'.

mv.stack.original.claim: Original site is a single-route Webflow export plus a custom bundle (GSAP 3.13 SplitText/ScrambleText/CustomEase, Lenis 1.3.4, OGL WebGL).

mv.stack.clone.claim: Clone is React 18 + Vite 5; the Webflow stylesheet is ported to src/styles/webflow.css, global embed CSS lives in src/index.css; tailwind.config.js holds colour/font tokens but no Tailwind layers are emitted (preflight off, no @tailwind directives).

mv.structure.routes-single.claim: Exactly one route: '/'. The clone has no router; App renders one page.

mv.structure.section-order.claim: Real render order: nav, header#intro (hero), section#content, section#cta (1st), section#cta (2nd), section#signup, footer; then a fixed WebGL canvas layer placed after the page wrapper.

mv.structure.duplicate-cta-id.claim: Two sections carry id="cta" on the original (and the clone keeps it). The footer 'CTA' link therefore resolves to the first one.

mv.structure.mt-xl-undefined.claim: Right-hand text blocks carry class mt-xl, which is not defined anywhere in the stylesheet (no-op).

mv.structure.invalid-nth-child.claim: The original counter CSS has two invalid nth-child selectors (n*2+2, n*3+1) that browsers drop; only even list items get translateX(10%) at >=991px.

mv.structure.discord-hidden.claim: The nav contains a Discord icon link, but .link-c{display:none} hides it at every width.

mv.structure.marquee-no-dom.claim: Marquee CSS (.scroller-*) exists but there is no marquee DOM on the live page. No marquee section exists in this design-repo, by design.

mv.structure.data-delay-unused.claim: data-delay="1" is present on the hero sub-lines but is not read by the motion code (no effect).

mv.color.black.claim: --black #0c0c0c is the page background (and is the variable animated by the solve flash).

mv.color.blush.claim: --white is actually pink #f5d0e6, used for all text, borders, lines and dots.

citations.quote: used for all text, borders, lines, dots

mv.color.grey.claim: --grey #707070 is the focused-input bottom border colour, which is invisible because the bottom border style is none.

citations.quote: so it has no visible effect

mv.color.solve-flash.claim: Solve easter egg tweens --black to a random choice of #b71234 or #0046ad, then back.

mv.color.submit-text.claim: Submit button text is #fff (from .w-button), overriding the pink.

mv.color.button-hover.claim: Pill button hover: background --white (#f5d0e6), text --black; transition color .2s, background-color .4s.

mv.font.faces.claim: Loaded faces: Helvetica Neue 400/700, Helvetica Neue Condensed 700, Firacode 400/700; all font-display:block.

mv.font.unused-neuemontreal.claim: Neuemontreal faces are declared in the CSS but never used; excluded from tokens.

citations.quote: it is **never used or loaded**, so skip it

mv.font.licensing.claim: Helvetica Neue and Helvetica Neue Condensed are commercial typefaces; the evidence ships them as woff2 files copied from the original's CDN with no licence file. No licence file for Firacode exists in the project either.
mv.font.licensing.basis: The commercial status of Helvetica Neue is general knowledge, not a measurement. No licence text exists anywhere in the source project (checked: public/assets/fonts holds only .woff2 files).

mv.type.roles.claim: Computed text roles (family / size / line-height / letter-spacing / weight / transform) at 1440 and 375.

citations.quote: | role | selector | family | size / line-height | ls | weight | transform |

mv.type.body.claim: Body: Helvetica Neue 14px / 1.1em, colour --white, cursor crosshair.

mv.type.display.claim: Display sizes: hero 9vw (11vw <=991 and <=767, 3.9rem <=479) lh .8em; list 7vw (9vw <=767, 12vw <=479) lh .9em; block 5vw (11vw <=767, 13vw <=479; .py-xs 9vw/12vw/14vw) lh .8em; footer 18vw (15vw <=767, 20vw <=479) lh .8em.

mv.type.mono.claim: Mono labels: Firacode .8rem / 1em, letter-spacing .1em, uppercase; .xs = 10px; at <=479 .font-fira becomes 1em.

mv.type.cta-tx-discrepancy.claim: Correction to CLONE_SPEC §1: '.cta-tx sets 1rem' only holds at <=479px. In both the original stylesheet and the port, .cta-tx{font-size:1rem} appears once, inside the max-width:479px block; at wider widths CTA text inherits .button-c 1.2rem (nav .button-c.sm 1rem).

mv.radius.pill.claim: Pill buttons: border-radius 3em (48px at 16px font, 57.6px at 19.2px).

mv.spacing.section.claim: Section padding 10vh 3vw 5vh, min-height 50vh; hero padding-top 5vh / bottom 1vh / min-height 90vh; signup padding-top 20vh; footer padding-top 15vh (5vh <=479) bottom 1vh; <=767 sections padding-top 5vh.

mv.spacing.container.claim: Container .c: width 80% (90% <=991), margin 2em auto; .c.py-lg margin 10em vertical; .c.flex-hb gap 2em; .mt-md margin-top 3rem; .tb-he.py-xs margin 1rem 0.

mv.spacing.button.claim: Pill button: padding .6em 1.2em, margin 1.2em 1rem, gap 3em (2em <=767, 1rem <=479), border 1px --white.

mv.spacing.unused-vars.claim: --space--py 5vh / --space--px 3vw are declared but only used by the unused .fx-w.

mv.breakpoints.claim: Webflow breakpoints max-width 991 / 767 / 479; counters use min-width:991px.

mv.layering.stack.claim: Nav z-index 20 fixed; canvas fixed full-viewport z-index -10, placed after the page wrapper; .pw/.w create no stacking context.

mv.layering.z-words.claim: .z words render BEHIND the WebGL canvas (z-index -11; .z.minus -21). Used on hero 'LIMITS', list items MANIPULATIONS/COMPILERS/PERFORMANCE, 'THE' in FIND THE MISSING PIECE, footer CODE (.z.minus) and FLOW.

citations.quote: `.z` is used on: the hero word "LIMITS"

mv.layering.z-tablet-reset.claim: At <=991 .z becomes position:static; z-index:0, so the 'behind-canvas' words paint in front of the canvas at tablet/mobile widths.

mv.icon.sizes.claim: Logo .logo.xs width 2.5rem (rendered 40x38); arrow .btn-ic width .8em; Discord .icon width 1rem margin 1rem.

mv.section.nav.claim: Nav: fixed bar with intro paragraph (40%), centre version tag (20%), right cluster (hidden Discord link, small CTA to #signup, logo).

mv.section.hero.claim: Hero header#intro: scrambled eyebrow, 3-line display h1 with a behind-canvas last word, two mono sub-lines (regular + bold), pill CTA to #signup, price note.

mv.section.content.claim: section#content: mono heading, 20-item counter list of display words (3 behind canvas), mono summary.

mv.section.features.claim: First section#cta: two rows (.c.flex-hb.py-lg) of two text blocks (label / 2-line heading / body / optional mono note).

citations.quote: export function Block({ label, l1, l2, children, mono, right })

mv.section.pitch.claim: Second section#cta: kicker + 2-line display heading (one behind-canvas word) + CTA + price note; one row of two text blocks; a 3-column price timeline table (header row + 2 rows) hidden <=767.

mv.section.signup.claim: section#signup: left column heading/body/3 perks; right column name+email form with animated underlines, locked submit, success and failure states.

mv.section.footer.claim: Footer: social link row; giant 4-word condensed wordmark (THE / CODE / FLOW / CO) interleaved with a site-nav block and a logo/legal block; CODE and FLOW render behind the canvas.

mv.section.canvas.claim: Fixed full-viewport WebGL layer after the page wrapper rendering a 3-layer Rubik's cube with a matcap shader.

mv.responsive.nav.claim: Nav: <=991 intro 50% wide, centre tag hidden, right cluster flex:1; <=767 intro hidden, solid --black background, cluster row-reversed (logo left, CTA right); <=479 full width, cluster padded 1.4rem, CTA margins 0.

mv.responsive.counters.claim: List counters ("001 "...) and even-item 10% offsets only at >=991px; below that, no offset and no counter.

citations.quote: Below 991px there is no offset and no counter.

mv.responsive.data-hide.claim: data-hide=tablet hides at <=991; data-hide=mobile hides at <=767 (timeline table, Discord link).

mv.responsive.flex-hb.claim: Two-column rows (.c.flex-hb) stack into a column at <=991; text blocks widen to 70% (<=991) and 90% (<=767).

mv.responsive.footer.claim: Footer: tablet-hidden blocks (site nav, footer logo) disappear <=991; at <=479 the last row wraps, legal block left-aligns full width, padding-top 5vh.

mv.responsive.hero.claim: Hero heading nowrap at desktop; wraps (white-space normal) at <=767; break-spaces at 3.9rem <=479. Hero is 810px tall at 1440x900, 731 at 375x812.

mv.responsive.signup.claim: Signup halves (._1-2) are 50% x 26vw at desktop; <=991 70% auto height; <=767 100%. Join-list text .6rem at <=479.

mv.motion.page-fade.claim: Page wrapper starts visibility:hidden and fades in: autoAlpha 1, duration 1s, delay .2s, default ease power1.out.

mv.motion.observer-replay.claim: Every reveal fires at 50% visibility of the whole element and resets instantly when the element fully leaves; animations replay on each re-entry.

citations.quote: **So every animation replays each time the element re-enters**

mv.motion.text-reveal.claim: Word/line reveal: split into lines (overflow hidden) then words; y 150% -> 0%, 1.2s expo.out, delay .1s (0 on mobile UA), stagger .05s from start.

citations.quote: duration:1.2, ease:"expo.out", delay: isMobileUA ? 0 : 0.1, stagger:{each:0.05, from:"start"}

mv.motion.char-drop.claim: Footer wordmark uses char split with data-y=-150%, so characters drop in from above.

citations.quote: The footer uses `data-y="-150%"` so its chars drop in from above.
gsap.to(el, { autoAlpha: 1, duration: 1.2, ease: EASE, delay: 0.1 })

mv.motion.scramble.claim: Scramble: alpha reveal plus scrambleText over 0.6-0.9s with chars "▖▗ ▘ ▙ ▚ ▛ ▜ ▝ ▞ ▟", revealDelay .3s, speed 1; inner markup flattened to text.

mv.motion.scale.claim: Scale reveal (s / sx): from 0 to 1, duration 1.2-1.4s expo.out, delay .1s, transform-origin 'right center' unless data-origin (name-field underline uses 'left center'). 'sy' exists in code but no element uses it.

mv.motion.button-hover.claim: CTA hover: CSS colour .2s / background .4s; on non-mobile UA it also tweens the cube hover uniform to 1 (expo.out 1.2s): lower half darkens, sticker colours hint, scale +0.02.

citations.quote: This tweens the shader `hover` value with `{hover: v, ease:"expo.out", duration:1.2}`
// CTA hover darkens the cube (desktop only)

mv.motion.link-hover.claim: Footer nav links: opacity .5 on hover, transition opacity .2s. Other links have no hover style.

mv.motion.cube-drop.claim: Cube drops in from 3 units above with back.out over 1.2s once GLB + textures load.

mv.motion.cube-idle.claim: Idle: continuous tumble plus a layer twist every 1680ms (0.8 x 2100), 0.8s per twist; scroll progress lifts (0.45 units), scales (+0.05, not on mobile UA) and spins the cube.

citations.quote: Scroll therefore moves the cube up (by 0.45 units over the full page)

mv.motion.cube-click.claim: Click anywhere: cube pushes back and springs (click 0 -> 5 over 1.6s, CustomEase bump returning to 0).

mv.motion.cube-solve.claim: Solve (key '!' or form success): stickers turn fully coloured (1.8s elastic.out, delay .4) and --black flashes to #b71234 or #0046ad (1.2s elastic.out, delay .4) then restores.

mv.motion.easepack-fallback.claim: Original asks for slow.out / slow.inOut but EasePack is not bundled, so GSAP falls back to power1.out; the clone uses power1.out explicitly.

mv.motion.lenis.claim: Smooth scroll: Lenis duration 1.2, easing min(1, 1.001 - 2^(-10t)), smoothWheel, touchMultiplier 2, native touch.

mv.motion.anchor-scroll-source.claim: On the original, #signup anchors are NOT handled by Lenis (anchors:false); the Webflow runtime does its own smooth anchor scroll. The clone (as edited 2026-10-23 by a concurrent session) reproduces it via lenis.scrollTo with a distance-based duration max(0, 472.143*ln(dist+125) - 2000) ms and easeInOutCubic. Earlier clone revision used a fixed 1.2s Lenis expo ease (superseded).

citations.quote: The Webflow runtime does its own smooth anchor scroll.

mv.motion.mobile-ua.claim: 'Mobile' is decided by user-agent regex, not viewport width: mobile UA disables CTA-hover coupling, word delay, pointer offset and scroll-based scale.

citations.quote: The original decides "mobile" from the user agent, not the viewport width.

mv.motion.no-reduced-motion.claim: Neither the original nor the clone handles prefers-reduced-motion (0 matches in app.js, src/ and the stylesheets). Every reducedMotionFallback in this design-repo is therefore a design-repo POLICY for generated output, not observed behaviour.
mv.motion.no-reduced-motion.basis: grep -r 'prefers-reduced-motion|reduced' over the saved app.js, src/ and both stylesheets returned 0 matches on 2026-10-23.

mv.form.lock.claim: Submit starts locked (.lock opacity .3, not-allowed) and unlocks when every non-email input is valid (i.e. name filled); email is not JS-checked.

citations.quote: the button unlocks (removes `.lock`, `pointer-events:auto`) as soon as the Name field is non-empty

mv.form.success.claim: On success the form hides, the success block shows (scrambled 'YOU ARE IN.' / 'Catch up soon!') and the cube solve animation runs. Failure shows 'Something went wrong. Try again?'.

mv.endpoint.mailchimp.claim: The original form posts to a live MailChimp list endpoint (ooo.us21.list-manage.com).

mv.endpoint.clone-has-no-action.claim: The clone's form has no action attribute (verified): it fakes success locally.

citations.quote: <form id="email-form" name="email-form" data-name="Email Form" method="post" className="lead-c" aria-label="Email Form">
There is no MailChimp backend here

mv.endpoint.umami.claim: The original loads Umami analytics with a real website id and tracks 'Signup Success'. The clone loads no analytics.

mv.identity.author-links.claim: Footer carries the real author's links: https://federic.ooo/s/twitter, https://federic.ooo/ and a privacy-policy Google Doc.

mv.identity.author-name.claim: The author's full name (Federico Valla) was supplied by the requester; it does not appear in any on-disk evidence file (the page identifies the author only as federic.ooo).
mv.identity.author-name.basis: grep for 'Federico' over the saved page, CLONE_SPEC.md and src/ returned 0 matches on 2026-10-23.

mv.asset.logo.claim: Logo "THE CODE FLOW. CO": inline SVG, viewBox 0 0 53 50, fill hardcoded #F5D0E6, used twice (nav + footer).

citations.quote: <div class="logo xs w-embed"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 53 50"

mv.asset.arrow.claim: Arrow icon: inline SVG viewBox 0 0 14 14, fill currentColor, used in every CTA (x3).

mv.asset.discord.claim: Discord icon: third-party trademark glyph, inline SVG viewBox 0 0 17 14, hidden on the site.

mv.asset.cube-model.claim: Rubik's cube GLB (cube8.glb, 648,832 B, 3 layer meshes) from the original's Webflow uploads.

mv.asset.cube-textures.claim: Matcaps mtc16.webp / mtc3.webp (1080x1080) and sticker colour map col_map.webp (540x540).

mv.meta.copy.claim: Page title 'Join Waitlist — thecodeflow.co' and meta description.

citations.quote: Level up your Webflow game by learning Javascript.

mv.copy.real-text.claim: Real copy for every section, used verbatim in schema/example.pagespec.json (evidence-reference provenance) and as the basis of every maxWords budget.

citations.quote: mono="* THEN 250? Maybe 300? Maybe more? not sure"

mv.copy.budget-policy.claim: maxWords budget per text field = max(real + 2, ceil(real x 1.5)) where 'real' is the longest real instance of that field. Words are whitespace-separated tokens after stripping ** and __ inline markers.
mv.copy.budget-policy.basis: The real word counts are measured from the source copy; the 1.5x headroom formula is a design-repo policy, not a measurement.

mv.qa.pixel.claim: Pixel QA 2026-10-23: clone matches the original at 1440x900 and 375x812 with zero static deltas. Doc height 7047 (1440) / 6884 (375). Section y/h at 1440: hero 0/810, content 810/2249, cta1 3059/1177, cta2 4236/1465, signup 5701/655, footer 6356/691.
mv.qa.pixel.basis: QA report handed to this build (2026-10-23). The section geometry independently matches the Playwright measurements recorded in CLONE_SPEC.md.

mv.qa.motion-match.claim: Motion QA 2026-10-23 (clone vs live original) MATCHED within tolerance: page fade, word/char reveal, alpha, scale s/sx, scramble, button hover, footer link hover, cube CTA-hover darkening, '!' solve flash, cube rest size/position, and (after the 60fps re-measure) anchor scroll and wheel scroll. No open motion deltas remain.
mv.qa.motion-match.basis: QA report handed to this build (2026-10-23); no QA artifact file is stored in the source project.

mv.qa.anchor-scroll.claim: MATCHED (re-measured at 60fps, 2026-10-23): anchor-link scroll to #signup matches the original within ~35ms at 50/90/99% progress, after the clone switched to the Webflow-style distance-based duration + easeInOutCubic. Superseded earlier finding: clone snapped out and hit 99% at ~0.66s vs original ~1.7s.
mv.qa.anchor-scroll.basis: 60fps re-measurement reported by the concurrent session that edited src/motion/scroll.js (relayed by the orchestrator, 2026-10-23). The code change itself is verified on disk (see mv.motion.anchor-scroll-source).

citations.quote: match the Webflow runtime's anchor scroll

mv.qa.wheel-scroll.claim: MATCHED (re-measured at 60fps, 2026-10-23): wheel scroll matches the original. The earlier '~100ms slower to 50%' finding was sampling noise; the Lenis wheel config is unchanged.
mv.qa.wheel-scroll.basis: 60fps re-measurement reported by the concurrent session (relayed by the orchestrator, 2026-10-23). Lenis config verified unchanged on disk.

mv.form.underline.claim: Inputs and timeline rows use a 1px --white rule (.line.abs, absolutely positioned at the bottom); before its sx reveal the input underline rests at scaleX(.5).

mv.form.input.claim: Input box 504x38 at 1440 (max-width 60ch), padding 8px 12px, transparent 1px border with no bottom border; visible underline is the .line element.

mv.measure.section-heights.claim: Every template section was measured at a 1440x900 viewport on a local production build of the source page; heights are rendered getBoundingClientRect().height after 3s of motion settling, written to sectionHeights by extraction/measure_sections.mjs.
mv.measure.section-heights.basis: Playwright/Chromium measurement of a local vite build of this project (no live-site capture exists in this repo, so this is a clone measurement, not a live-site measurement). Re-run extraction/measure_sections.mjs --write after any page change.

sectionHeights.$comment: Rendered height of every template section at 1440x900, written by extraction/measure_sections.mjs and read by extraction/wrapper_gate.py. heightPx/position/inFlow/pageHeight/measuredOn are machine-written; selector/nth say how each section was found on the source page. inFlow=false means position fixed/absolute (an overlay that takes no page height).
